annotations.title: Run engine ops in one call

description:
Send a list of raw engine ops (AddNode, SetProp, RunVerification...) in one call: one undo step unless an op must travel alone, and one save at the end. Ask for receipt summary on long lists. For computed edits, summer_run_script is simpler.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/batch"}

ops.description: Array of operation objects, each with 'op' plus its parameters

receipt.description: full (default): every engine receipt. summary: counts, failures with op index, created node paths only (under 5 KB).

scenePath.description: Required when ops contains scene mutations; exact res:// target scene path

name: summer_batch
title: Run engine ops in one call
